scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "ctrl,gate,dash,port" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev -w @cn/controller" "npm run dev -w @cn/gateway" "npm run dev -w @cn/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @cn/portal"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cn/shared && npm run build --workspace @cn/controller && npm run build --workspace @cn/gateway && npm run build --workspace @cn/dashboard && npm run build --workspace @cn/portal && npm run build --workspace @cn/agent
